title: Renewals
description: Season pass renewal campaigns: proposals with right of pre-emption, sending, acceptances and spots released at the deadline.

problem.renewal_expired: The pre-emption period has expired: the spot has been released.
problem.credit_insufficient: Insufficient credit: the balance cannot become negative.
problem.season_rollover_conflict: A season for that year already exists and was not created by this rollover.

accept.title: Accept the renewal
accept.confirmNowHelp: The renewal is confirmed now; the balance is recorded at the cash desk as for any booking.
accept.awaitPaymentHelp: The booking stays awaiting payment and is confirmed when the payment arrives.

deadline.help: Pre-emption ends at 23:59 on the chosen day (establishment time).

create.title: New campaign
create.description: One proposal for each pass holder of the source season, with the same spot and the price of the new price list.
create.deadlineHelp: Until this date the spot stays reserved for the pass holder.
create.name: Name
create.previewHint: Use "Preview" to see the proposals and the excluded passes before creating them.
create.done_one: Campaign created: {{count}} proposal ready to send.
create.done_other: Campaign created: {{count}} proposals ready to send.

skip.spot_unavailable: Spot not available in the new season
skip.no_price: No price in the new price list

campaign.changeDeadlineHelp: Applies to the proposals still waiting.
campaign.closeDescription_one: {{count}} proposal still open will be closed and its spot released.
campaign.closeDescription_other: {{count}} proposals still open will be closed and their spots released.

proposals.title: Renewal proposals
proposals.emptyHint: Change the filters or create a new campaign.

empty.title: No renewal campaigns
empty.description: Prepare the new season with the end-of-season rollover, then offer renewals to pass holders.

bulk.sendUnsent: Send to those who have not received it
bulk.remind: Remind those who have not replied

send.title: Send the proposals?
send.description_one: The email with the renewal link goes out for {{count}} proposal (even if already sent).
send.description_other: The email with the renewal link goes out for {{count}} proposals (even if already sent).

accept.title: Accept the renewals?
accept.description_one: {{count}} renewal is confirmed at the desk.
accept.description_other: {{count}} renewals are confirmed at the desk.

decline.title: Decline the renewals?
decline.description_one: {{count}} proposal is declined and the spot released.
decline.description_other: {{count}} proposals are declined and the spots released.

release.title: Release the spots now?
release.description_one: Pre-emption of {{count}} proposal ends now, even if it has not expired.
release.description_other: Pre-emption of {{count}} proposals ends now, even if it has not expired.

unsent.title: Send the proposals not yet sent?
unsent.description: Every pass holder with an email who has not received the proposal yet gets the renewal link.

remind.title: Send a reminder?
remind.description: All pass holders who have not replied yet receive the renewal link again.

releaseExpired.title: Release expired pre-emptions?
releaseExpired.description: The spots of unanswered proposals past their deadline become bookable again.
